From 350de5b8a9befaa2a68861c51f671d4f5f751ca5 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Amery Hung <ameryhung@gmail.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 19:57:16 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] bpf: Do not allow deleting local storage in NMI

Currently, local storage may deadlock when deferring freeing selem or
local storage through kfree_rcu(), call_rcu() or call_rcu_tasks_trace()
in NMI or reentrant. Since deleting selem in NMI is an unlikely use
case, partially mitigate it by returning error when calling from
bpf_xxx_storage_delete() helpers in NMI. Note that, it is still possible
to deadlock through reentrant. A full mitigation requires returning
error when irqs_disabled() is true, which, however is too heavy-handed
for bpf_xxx_storage_delete().

The long-term solution requires _nolock versions of call_rcu. Another
possible solution is to defer the free through irq_work [0], but it
would grow the size of selem, which is non-ideal.

The check is only needed in bpf_selem_unlink(), which is used by helpers
and syscalls. bpf_selem_unlink_nofail() is fine as it is called during
map and owner tear down that never run in NMI or reentrant.

[0] https://lore.kernel.org/bpf/20260205190233.912-1-alexei.starovoitov@gmail.com/

Fixes: a10787e6d58c ("bpf: Enable task local storage for tracing programs")
Signed-off-by: Amery Hung <ameryhung@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Martin KaFai Lau <martin.lau@kernel.org>
Acked-by: Kumar Kartikeya Dwivedi <memxor@gmail.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260319025716.2361065-1-ameryhung@gmail.com

diff --git a/kernel/bpf/bpf_local_storage.c b/kernel/bpf/bpf_local_storage.c
index 9c96a4477f81..4c6079d2cf28 100644
--- a/kernel/bpf/bpf_local_storage.c
+++ b/kernel/bpf/bpf_local_storage.c
@@ -393,6 +393,9 @@ int bpf_selem_unlink(struct bpf_local_storage_elem *selem)
 	unsigned long flags;
 	int err;
 
+	if (in_nmi())
+		return -EOPNOTSUPP;
+
 	if (unlikely(!selem_linked_to_storage_lockless(selem)))
 		/* selem has already been unlinked from sk */
 		return 0;
-- 
2.34.1

The patch modifies a single file, `kernel/bpf/bpf_local_storage.c`, by adding a guard clause to the `bpf_selem_unlink()` function. This function is used by BPF helper calls (e.g., `bpf_sk_storage_delete()`) and syscalls to unlink a storage element.

**Modification in `bpf_local_storage.c`:**  
- Added `if (in_nmi()) return -EOPNOTSUPP;` at the beginning of `bpf_selem_unlink()` to immediately reject any attempt to delete local storage while executing in a non-maskable interrupt (NMI) context.

**Relationship:**  
This change is self-contained within the file. It only affects the path taken when a BPF program running in NMI tries to delete local storage; it prevents the subsequent call to memory-freeing functions (like `kfree_rcu()`, `call_rcu()`, or `call_rcu_tasks_trace()`) that could cause deadlocks in NMI or reentrant contexts. The sibling function `bpf_selem_unlink_nofail()` is explicitly not modified because it is invoked only during map/owner teardown, which never occurs in NMI.
